reviews.comment: I got into this class on a technicality. Because I am taking Anth as a minor, I didn't take all of the prereqes. She allowed me to continue, and it was an amazing and insightful class. I learned most during the seminars, especially when I read the papers beforehand. Active discussion is definitely the way to go. She's also very approachable!

Osteology is hard but Dr. Wright tries to make it as easy as possible. Test are cumulative and consist of 20 stations where you have to identify bones, features, and the side them. There is a semester long project that isn't hard if you pay attention and actually follow instructions. She also hold study sessions to help prepare for exams.

Osteology is a hands on class, in order for you to learn how bones work you have be in class! The class is fast paced and Dr. Wright will give you some handouts so you could follow along, but if you don't take notes on them they wont be much help. She gives quizzes on videos which are easy, but you have to watch them! Good luck and STUDY!

My favorite professor to date, but not easy! Truly cares about student success. Do not skip this class. Attendance is the only way to  pass. Tough material, but she makes it interesting and is very approachable.
